cases.rationale: Clean NiO + WO3 partial-reaction control containing 60 wt% wolframite NiWO4 and stoichiometrically paired residual NiO/WO3. The registered ordered truth is naturally absent from the library because the sole exact NiWO4 record duplicates symmetry-equivalent sites; the nearest physical survivor is tier-1 MgWO4 COD 9013902 (Mg->Ni, framework RMS 0.0000, 2.09% cell mismatch). Zero offset and specimen effects are controlled so this easier carryover variation isolates source-quality rejection and analogue adaptation from profile nuisance complexity.

CuO + WO3 intermediate/unreacted mixture containing cubic Cu3WO6, residual tenorite and monoclinic WO3 at an exact overall 1:1 Cu:W balance. The exact Cu3WO6 reference is available (tier 0), but the nominal CuWO4 product is absent from the truth and remains a convincing compositional decoy in the library. This tests whether the solver follows unexplained peaks to an off-stoichiometric intermediate and retains residual CuO instead of forcing the expected target, under ordinary multiphase specimen/profile effects.
